Vayne_0.jpg.note: Face looks almost straight at the camera with a very slight tilt, while the body angles toward the left with the leg and crossbow arm thrust that way.

Veigar_0.jpg.note: Face with glowing eyes is nearly frontal but turns slightly left, and the body lunges toward the left with a big armored arm reaching that way.

Velkoz_0.jpg.note: Vel'Koz's central eye looks almost straight at the camera, with only a slight lean, so it reads as center.

Vex_0.jpg.note: Head is tilted and turned slightly toward the right, with the nose and gaze pointing right; the body is mostly frontal, so the lean is subtle. No text or logos are visible.

Vi_0.jpg.note: Face and torso are nearly square to the camera with only a slight head tilt, so center was chosen; no readable text or logos appear.

Viego_0.jpg.note: Face is nearly square to the camera with only a slight turn, and the head is tilted down; the body is angled slightly, so center is a close call.

Viktor_0.jpg.note: Helmet and face are nearly square to the camera with only a slight turn, and the shoulders are level, so this is treated as center.  The brooch on the cloak is a small ornament, not readable text.  ‌

Vladimir_0.jpg.note: Head is tilted back and nearly square to the camera with only a slight lean, so no clear side; no text or emblems.

Volibear_0.jpg.note: The snout and snarl point toward the left edge. A glowing rune glyph on the armband would read wrong if mirrored.

Warwick_0.jpg.note: The snout and snarling jaw point down and to the left while the head is partly turned to the camera, and the body extends to the right behind the head.

Xayah_0.jpg.note: Her face looks nearly square to the camera with a slight tilt, while her body leans toward the left with the shoulder skull pointing right, so there is no clear lean.

Xerath_0.jpg.note: The champion is mostly hidden behind a burst of shattering shackles and blue energy, so the face is not visible and the body is blurred with no clear lean.

Yasuo_0.jpg.note: Face is turned slightly toward the viewer's left with eyes looking down and left, while his body lunges leftward with the arm extended that way.

Yone_0.jpg.note: Face is in three-quarter view turned toward the left edge, while the shoulders and sword stay roughly square; the glowing rune on the blade is abstract, so flipping is fine.

Yorick_0.jpg.note: Face looks down at the camera from a low angle, nearly square, with a very slight turn toward the left; the large shoulder on the right is not a lean.

Yunara_0.jpg.note: Face is turned slightly toward the viewer's left with the glowing eye on that side, and the body and outstretched arm reach left; the gaze is nearly forward, so the turn is subtle.

Yuumi_0.jpg.note: Face is nearly square to the camera, tilted upward, with only a slight turn; the body leans a little toward the viewer's right.

Zaahen_0.jpg.note: Face is turned toward the viewer's left in three-quarter view, gazing off to the left, while the shoulders are broader to the right.

Zac_0.jpg.note: Zac's face looks nearly straight at the camera, with only a slight tilt, and no text or logos appear.

Zed_0.jpg.note: The helmet faces the camera nearly square, with only a slight lean toward the left, while the body crouches and angles toward the right.

Zeri_0.jpg.note: Face looks nearly square to the camera with a slight head tilt; body leans a little to the left with the legs kicked out left, but no clear turn.

Ziggs_0.jpg.note: Ziggs' face and grin point toward the left edge while his body trails off to the right; the bomb markings are a stylized skull-like shape, not readable text.

Zilean_0.jpg.note: Zilean's face is in three-quarter view turned toward the image's left, with his gaze also directed left; the faint runes on the time circle are decorative and not readable text.

Zoe_0.jpg.note: Face is nearly square to the camera, tilted slightly with eyes glancing right; body is mostly facing the viewer with no clear lean.

Zyra_0.jpg.note: Face is turned toward the viewer's left and her thorny vine arm reaches out to the left; no text or logos appear.
